question: At which event was Ram Charan awarded the title of Ambassador for Indian Art and Culture?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Indian Film Festival of Melbourne (IFFM) 2024**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Film Festival of Melbourne (IFFM)** is one of the most prestigious film festivals held annually in **Melbourne, Australia**, celebrating Indian cinema and its global impact.
 
• In **2024**, renowned actor **Ram Charan** was honored with the title of **Ambassador for Indian Art and Culture**.
 
• This recognition highlights his contribution to promoting **Indian cinema** and culture on a global platform.
 
• The festival serves as a bridge between **Indian and Australian cultural ties**, fostering understanding through the medium of films.
 
• Ram Charan, known for his remarkable performances in films like **RRR**, has gained international acclaim, making him a fitting choice for this honor.
 
• The IFFM often features **screenings, panel discussions, and cultural events**, providing a platform for Indian artists to showcase their talents to a global audience.
 
• This award not only celebrates Ram Charan's achievements but also emphasizes the growing influence of **Indian cinema** in the global entertainment industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cannes Film Festival**__

 __
 
• The **Cannes Film Festival** is an annual film festival held in **Cannes, France**, showcasing new films from around the world.
 
• It is one of the most prestigious and highly publicized events in the global film industry.
 
• The festival features categories such as the **Palme d'Or**, awarded for the best film.
 
• Although Indian films are often featured, this event did not host the specific recognition for Ram Charan in 2024.
 
 
 
• **International Film Festival of India (IFFI)**__
 __
 
• The **International Film Festival of India (IFFI)** is held annually in **Goa, India**, showcasing the best of Indian and world cinema.
 
• It is one of the most significant film festivals in Asia, organized by the **Government of India**.
 
• While IFFI highlights Indian cinema extensively, Ram Charan received his award at the **IFFM 2024**, not at this event.
 
 
 
• **Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF)**__
 
 
• The **Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF)** is one of the largest publicly attended film festivals in the world, held annually in **Toronto, Canada**.
 
• It is known for its diverse lineup of films and often serves as a launchpad for award-season contenders.
 
• Although Indian films have been showcased here, Ram Charan's recognition as an ambassador happened at the **IFFM 2024**.
